message.reasoning_content: License income 20-60 alashi is huge compared to bank (30 alashi). Opponents have ~30 alashi cash each and may bid. My max bid 2.19 alashi — likely lose unless opponents don't bid. Low cash anyway; still, bid all — if win, huge. But my cash is needed? Promissory 37.5 already converts next round to cash after devaluation... Ranking uses cash+hard only. Small bid of 1 alashi probably loses. Better bid all 2.19; cost only if win (still fine: 30% bank + license). Actually if I win, my bid goes to bank, increasing pool. Still worth it. Choose 10.
